name: io.github.Phenotype-Brandvoz/perfectplaintiff-injury-lawsuit-data
title: perfectplaintiff.com injury lawsuit data
description: Sourced figures on U.S. injury lawsuits by state, court and case type, each with its source.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find figures about injury lawsuits (one sourced figure each), datasets and law firm profiles by words: a subject, a measure, a state, a firm. Returns ids to pass to fetch. Example: "plaintiff win rate at trial Texas", "Morgan & Morgan".

query.description: What to look for, in plain words.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full text of one search result: the figure in a sentence with its place, period, label and source, how it was calculated, the known limits, the page and the credit line.

id.description: An id from search, e.g. "finding:texas-personal-injury-plaintiff-win-share" or "firm:morgan-and-morgan".

tools.name: list_findings
tools.description: The newsroom's findings (one figure in a sentence each), for the nation, one of the states covered, or New York City, and optionally one kind of case.

place.description: "United States", a state name such as "Texas", or "New York City". Optional: the nation.

case_type.description: A kind of case, e.g. "motor vehicle", "medical malpractice". Optional: all personal injury.

tools.name: get_finding
tools.description: One finding as data: figure, statement, label (Sourced, Computed or Estimated), sources with the date retrieved and reuse terms, how it was calculated, limits, credit line, page and CSV.

id.description: The finding id, with or without the "finding:" prefix.

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: The datasets in the data library with their files, columns and row counts: federal injury cases by court, state and year, class actions, multidistrict litigation, judges, tort claim payments and more. Filter by words.

query.description: Words to match in the name or description. Optional.

tools.name: query_dataset
tools.description: Rows of one CSV file from the data library, filtered by column values. Use list_datasets to get a file path and its columns. Returns at most 200 rows a call; use offset for more.

file.description: The file path from list_datasets, e.g. "/data/federal-personal-injury-cases-by-year.csv".

tools.name: get_case_outcomes
tools.description: Every published figure for one place and kind of case: cases filed and closed, trials, plaintiff wins at trial, the share settled and days to closing, each with its label and source. Without a year: the latest year and multi-year figures.

place.description: The nation, a state, a federal district court or a county, e.g. "California".

case_type.description: A kind of case, e.g. "motor vehicle", "medical malpractice". Optional: all personal injury.

tools.name: get_law_firm_profile
tools.description: What named public sources state about one of 203 injury, mass tort and class action law firms: founding, offices, kinds of case, slogan and reported results. Each row says who states it. Not a rating; a firm's claims are not checked.

name.description: The firm's name, or part of it, e.g. "Morgan & Morgan".

tools.name: how_to_cite
tools.description: The credit line, the underlying sources and their reuse terms for a finding, a dataset or a law firm profile.

id.description: A finding, dataset or firm id.

tools.name: get_mdl_docket
tools.description: One federal multidistrict litigation (MDL) by number or name: actions pending, change over 1 and 12 months, new actions, surges, stage, upcoming court dates, trial outcomes, state court counts and the listed companies linked, each with label and source.

docket.description: An MDL number such as "3060", or words from its name, e.g. "hair relaxer".

tools.name: get_company_mass_torts
tools.description: The multidistrict litigations a listed company is linked to and on what basis, the amounts it states in its own filings (quoted, with the filing), how its disclosures changed in a year, and upcoming court dates. No estimates.

company.description: A company name or ticker, e.g. "Johnson & Johnson" or "JNJ".

tools.name: list_mass_tort_signals
tools.description: What is changing in mass torts: dockets that surged on the Panel's latest monthly report, requests to create new multidistrict litigations, and court dates and Panel hearings in the coming days (30 unless set).

days.description: How many days ahead to list court dates. Optional: 30.

from_date.description: First day for court dates, as YYYY-MM-DD. Optional: today.
